name: Single-Leg Hack Squat Calf Raise
steps: Set your back and shoulders against the hack squat pads and place both forefeet securely on the lower footplate with heels clear.
Stand up, release the catches and lift one foot clear while keeping the working knee slightly bent.
Let the working heel descend within a comfortable range, then push through the forefoot to rise onto your toes.
Replace the free foot and engage the catches before setting up on the other leg.
tips: Keep your working knee stationary so your quad does not help bounce the sled upward.
Place the ball of your foot squarely on the footplate so it cannot slip.
